title: The stone head from the water
logline: The face from the bay side, through the gap between Gully's shack and the wall: small, in the grass, looking out at the water it faces. The page finds out which way it looks.

panels.composition: From the water's edge: a narrow gap between a shingle bait shack and a wall, and through it, small in the grass, the carved stone face turned toward the bay.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, seen from the water's edge, a narrow gap between a shingle bait shack and a wall and through it a small moss-grown carved stone face in grass turned toward the bay, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
